what: The supervisor's shift sheet of stage 05: per tray slot the windows of the slot, the target list with times and the destination rest. It states no mass, centre or label of any tray. Produced by duty/sheet.py build_sheet (maintainers' file; the published format is worded from it).

fields.name: format_version
fields.meaning: Version of the shift sheet's format (1).

fields.name: cycle_s
fields.meaning: The exchange cycle (0.004 s). Every time of the sheet is a multiple of it; a slot time t corresponds to the supervisor's slot_cycle t / cycle_s.

fields.name: time_origin
fields.meaning: Shift times count from cycle 0, the end of the hand-over; slot times count from the cycle in which the supervisor's signal presents the slot's tray standing in F.

fields.name: frame
fields.meaning: Positions are tray reference points in the cell frame of the cell sheet (m), the tray level, its handle line along y.

fields.name: first_presentation_s
fields.meaning: Shift time at which the first tray is presented (the free interval after the hand-over).

fields.name: move_s
fields.meaning: Duration of one move of the timed reference: the reference point travels on the straight line from the previous target to the next, its path length by a trapezoid of equal thirds, the tray keeping its orientation.

fields.name: hold_s
fields.meaning: Duration of the hold that follows every move (the reference point stays at the target).

fields.name: lifted_point_above_seated_m
fields.meaning: The carry starts at the lifted point L, this far above the reference point of the tray standing in F.

fields.name: slots
fields.meaning: The tray slots of the shift in the order in which their trays are presented.

fields.name: slots[].tray
fields.meaning: Index of the slot (0 for the first), the value of the supervisor's signal site.tray while the slot's tray is presented.

fields.name: slots[].planned_presentation_s
fields.meaning: Shift time of the presentation when every earlier tray of the sheet is carried through its whole schedule; after a declined tray or a missed capture the next trays are presented earlier, and the supervisor's signal says when.

fields.name: slots[].job
fields.type: string, one of short | medium | lap
fields.meaning: The job's length class: short (12 to 16 targets), medium (24 to 32) or the lap (the acceptance list).

fields.name: slots[].pick_rest
fields.meaning: Where the tray stands when it is presented: F, the fixture.

fields.name: slots[].destination_rest
fields.meaning: Where the carried tray is set down: S, the shelf.

fields.name: slots[].n_targets
fields.meaning: Number of targets of the job n (the first fixed target and the last two fixed targets included); the carry consists of n moves, each followed by a hold.

fields.name: slots[].windows
fields.meaning: The slot's windows: closing [0, 5.0] (both grippers capture their necks by its end); trial_lift_and_decision [5.0, 9.0]; decline_accepted [0, 9.0]; carry [9.0, T_e] with T_e = 9.0 + n (move_s + hold_s); set_down [T_e, T_e + 6.0] (lowered from the pre-place point onto the destination rest, both grippers open); retreat [T_e + 6.0, T_e + 9.0] (both hands inside the clear volume by its end; then the supervisor takes the tray off S); next_tray_s T_e + 12.0. Each window is [start, end].

fields.name: slots[].declined
fields.meaning: The schedule after a decline sent at slot time t_d inside decline_accepted (and not after a missed capture): put_back_by_s (t_d + 4.0: the tray seated and released in F, its put-back deadline), hands_clear_by_s (t_d + 7.0: both hands inside the clear volume), next_tray_after_s (t_d + 10.0). Values are the offsets from t_d.

fields.name: slots[].missed_capture
fields.meaning: The schedule when a hand has not captured its neck by the end of closing and no decline was sent before it: the job has failed, a later decline is ignored; both grippers open and both hands inside the clear volume by clear_by_s (12.0); next tray at next_tray_s (15.0).

fields.name: slots[].targets
fields.meaning: The timed reference of the carry, in the job's order.

fields.name: slots[].targets[].k
fields.meaning: Index of the target in the job (0 for the first).

fields.name: slots[].targets[].p
fields.meaning: The target: the tray's reference point in the cell frame (x, y, z).

fields.name: slots[].targets[].move_start_s
fields.meaning: Start of the move to this target (from the previous target, or from L for k = 0): 9.0 + k (move_s + hold_s).

fields.name: slots[].targets[].arrive_s
fields.meaning: End of the move: the reference point is at the target (move_start_s + move_s).

fields.name: slots[].targets[].hold_end_s
fields.meaning: End of the hold at this target (arrive_s + hold_s); the next move starts here.

canonical_json: sorted keys, separators (',', ':'), ASCII; digests are sha256 of these bytes
example_note: An example of the format only: drawn from a fixed development entropy of its own, its job lists not checked by the generator; not the shift of any unit.

example.time_origin: shift times from cycle 0 (the end of the hand-over); slot times from the cycle in which the slot's tray is presented
example.frame: cell frame of the cell sheet; tray reference point; tray level; handle line along y
